The '''Corus-Calis Glacier Range''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elbara Nine]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] maintained a small base, [[GlitterFall]], within the Corus-Calis Glacier Range.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
